reviews.title: Downloaded maps
reviews.text: Last update go to field and all downloaded maps wouldn’t work and needed internet to update which still didn’t work for 10 percent. Additionally cannot copy gps coordinates which sucks when using satellite text to coordinate with others

reviews.title: Ok, I guess.
reviews.text: 3d maps are pixels and unclear when zooming in. Satellite images are older and outdated. 2D is clearer but also has older images.

reviews.title: sneaky & underhanded updates
reviews.text:
you used to be able to download 1 offline map at a time with a free account, but after i opened basemap recently it wouldn't let me redownload my offline map. when i tried, a little button popped up that said "update map: your offline map requires a small update to keep it accurate!"
when i clicked that button, the map was instantly deleted, and it will not let me redownload it without a paying account.

i have no problems with apps costing money, but marketing it as if there is a free option and then doing sneaky rollbacks like that undermines all integrity and trust.

reviews.title: Offline markers fail miserably
reviews.text: I made several markers on my laptop and tested them on the phone before heading out into the back country.  Long story short, they didn’t show up when I got out there and I had to call via satellite phone for help.  I asked for a refund and they never processed it.  Now a year later they charged me again for a subscription and refused to refund it but cancelled me anyway.  Just use On X.

reviews.title: Layers Tab
reviews.text: The layers tab is in one of the worst spots possible on the screen causing me to inadvertently hit it when Im maneuvering on the screen.

reviews.title: Broken app
reviews.text: Please re update the app. It won’t even open up. I’ll give it a week before I delete the app and go to an app that works. Locked out of my account goodbye.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Have had this app for 3 years and now locked out and wanting me to create a new account.  Apple login doesn’t work

reviews.title: Land owners are not accurate
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for years and enjoyed it. But the land maps have not refreshed in a year or so. That’s pretty annoying.

reviews.title: Love the app
reviews.text:
I loved it until I didn't. Support is non existent and they cannot fix the bugs. 

They add features, but it just makes things worse. Map layers is a cool thing but when it be one so slow as to be unusable it's no longer cool. 

This app has the perfect UI. I love it. But the company failed to make it work well. 

The new LiDar sucks. They say coverage is in here where it's available. It's not. OnX has it and it's responsive. Fast. 

This one. Slow as molasses to even show up and then only partial coverage. 

I've waited all season with them saying it'll get fixed. Absolutely nothing has changed. 

If I could get a refund I would. Don't buy this. Get something that works. FYI that's any other app.

reviews.title: OnX is better
reviews.text: I have been using Base Maps for several years. This is the last time I will use it. If I don’t have service, it won’t even open the app. This is a hunting app, most places I hunt don’t have phone service. Even when I download a map with layers to use offline, the map rarely loads correctly. I’m currently looking at the map to decide where to hunt tomorrow and none of my markers are showing up on the map. I currently have full phone service. This app is not worth the money anymore

reviews.title: Land ownership Boundaries not up to date
reviews.text:
I like to use the Land Ownership for Boundaries.
In my case here in Southeast Mo I reported the App was wrong and not updated and got a response.

Gary,

We last received an update for Stoddard county December of 2024. I passed this on to our GIS team to see if they can contact our provider about his county to see when we'll get an update for this county. 

Sincerely,
BaseMap Support Team

reviews.title: App just keeps crashing
reviews.text: I used the pro version of basemap for about 4 years and really liked it. Over the last year or probably more the app has been unusable. It opens for a brief second the crashes over and over. My wife, and good friend also have crashing issues. Had no choice but to use other hunting apps.
